job.name: ig7_host_b
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary-looking woman — not a celebrity, not a model.
job.meaning: женщина ~48, психолог: короткое серебристо-седое каре, без очков, чёрная водолазка, минималистичная белая студия с тенью оконной рамы; документальное интервью, взгляд вбок
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a woman about 48 years old, a psychologist: a sharp silver-grey chin-length bob, no glasses, minimal silver jewellery, a black fine-knit turtleneck and black trousers. Background: a minimalist off-white studio wall with the soft shadow of a window frame. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, centred, seen from mid-thigh up while seated on a simple armless chair, generous empty space around her, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, face sharp and detailed (the frame will also be cropped to tight close-ups). Head turned about 25 degrees to the left, eyes looking off-camera to the left as if answering an interviewer — a documentary interview shot. Expression: calm, smart and engaged, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted showing a hint of teeth, NO smile. Hands relaxed in her lap. Look: a candid still from a real high-end documentary interview, cinema camera, 50mm, f/2.8, soft natural window light from the left with a gentle shadow on the wall, natural unretouched skin with pores and fine lines, real hair flyaways. No microphone, no headphones, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

attempts.issue: The subject must be facing forward and looking directly into the camera.
